主要内容: Foresight Energy LP filed for bankruptcy in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Eastern District of Missouri, marking the latest coal company to fail as power generators shift to cleaner and cheaper fuels. The filing signals that efforts to reverse coal’s decline are not working. A wave of U.S. miners, including Murray Energy Corp., which owns a controlling stake in Foresight, have filed for Chapter 11 in recent years. Robert Murray, the owner of Murray Energy Corp., is a vocal supporter of President Donald Trump, who has pledged to save the coal industry.
